preconditions: Fresh leased Kind node, pinned Calico and exact retained IMP-10 developer image.

normal_steps.action: Access the deployed developer endpoint and active controls.
normal_steps.actual: Developer endpoint, Kubernetes API and cluster DNS reached from authorized fixture roles.

adverse_steps.action: Stop the leased Kind node and verify independent host Static.
adverse_steps.expected: Core disappears and same Native Static serves signed English and French during the outage.
adverse_steps.actual: Verified all observations and scoped Core recovery on the same node.

adverse_steps.action: Run protected Kubernetes workload and repeated load qualification.
adverse_steps.expected: Observed full protected mTLS, data, identity, private Help and model workload.

checks.name: calico-fixture-and-node-outage
checks.expected: Same-target fixture denials and independent signed Static survive an actual node stop.
checks.actual: Six same-target negatives passed; Core developer health dropped and recovered on the same node. Native signed EN/FR Static stayed reachable.

checks.name: deployed-api-and-dns-controls
checks.expected: Permitted control reaches each exact real cluster target before and after restricted request.
checks.actual: Allowed pod reached verified Kubernetes HTTPS and exact cluster DNS. Restricted pod timed out or received the resolver timeout error.

checks.name: archive-aware-planning
checks.expected: Verify current frozen digests with established archive-aware resolution.
checks.actual: All canonical planning hashes, stages, role and artifact references passed.

checks.name: protected-deployment-inventory
checks.expected: Inspect the exact retained image and distinguish module presence from an integrated deployment.
checks.actual: Training factory imports. The protected launcher lacks Training and Evaluation ports, and the replay policy must be supplied to the protected topology.

checks.name: protected-workload-mtls-and-live-service-probes
checks.expected: Observe the actual current protected role boundaries.
checks.actual: No complete isolated protected deployment composition is available for this candidate.

checks.name: protected-host-help-and-ten-session-timings
checks.expected: Verify protected independent Help with current Identity and measure repeated cold, warm and error cases under ten active sessions.
checks.actual: Protected topology and current role bindings are missing. Earlier loopback and single cold results retain their own evidence.

residuals: Bind the current protected Kubernetes roles, including Training and Evaluation in Core, Data replay custody, the Training proof audience and private Help Identity authority.
Run deployed protected mTLS and actual product dependency denial controls, plus the protected cluster outage with private Help and Static.
Repeat exact cold, warm and error timing observations at the declared ten-session workload.
acceptance_scope: Isolated developer image, deployed CNI controls and public Static continuity through an actual node outage.
rollback: Retain the exact restored local model and current authority settings. No service deployment or release was performed.
